aka.zh: 沪宁高速公路（上海至南京段）

tagline.en: Up the Yangtze from Shanghai to Chengdu; the last 173 km, through the Three Gorges mountains west of Yichang, took five years
tagline.zh: 溯长江自上海至成都；最后 173 公里穿越宜昌以西的三峡山区，修了五年

start.en: The Chengnan interchange on Chengdu's East Third Ring Road, in Chenghua district
start.zh: 四川省成都市成华区东三环成南立交

end.en: The Wuning Road interchange on Shanghai's Middle Ring Road, in Putuo district
end.zh: 上海市普陀区中环路武宁路立交

en: G42 follows the Yangtze inland across six provinces. It leaves Shanghai on the Shanghai–Nanjing expressway, shared with G2 as far as Wuxi, through Suzhou, Wuxi, Changzhou and Zhenjiang to Nanjing; crosses the Yangtze on the Third Nanjing Yangtze Bridge; runs with G40 through Hefei and Lu'an; climbs over the Dabie mountains into Hubei at Changlingguan; and passes Macheng and the north of Wuhan to Jingmen and Yichang. West of Yichang it goes through the mountains north of the Three Gorges to Badong and Wushan, then along the Yangtze through Fengjie, Yunyang and Wanzhou in Chongqing, and across the parallel ridges of eastern Sichuan by Linshui, Guang'an, Nanchong and Suining to Chengdu.

The chainage in Chinese Wikipedia runs to 1,980 km, the figure in the 2022 national plan: Shanghai 34 km, Jiangsu 324, Anhui 328, Hubei 597, Chongqing 343 and Sichuan 354. Xinhua gave 1,966 km when the road was completed in 2014.

The famous mountain road of western Hubei is not on G42 today. The Shanghai–Chengdu West expressway from Yichang through Enshi to Lichuan, with the Sidu River suspension bridge, was planned as part of this line and built in 2003–2010 under that project name, but the plan was then changed and the road is now part of G50, the Shanghai–Chongqing expressway. G42 crosses the same mountains further north, on the Yichang–Badong expressway.
zh: G42 沿长江向内陆延伸，穿越六个省市。它自上海经沪宁高速出城——至无锡与 G2 共线——经苏州、无锡、常州、镇江抵南京；经南京长江第三大桥过江；与 G40 共线经合肥、六安；翻越大别山，在长岭关进入湖北，经麻城、武汉北郊至荆门、宜昌。宜昌以西，它穿过三峡北侧的群山至巴东、巫山，再沿长江经重庆奉节、云阳、万州，越川东平行岭谷，经邻水、广安、南充、遂宁抵成都。
中文维基百科所列里程桩号至 1,980 公里，与 2022 年国家规划所列一致：上海 34 公里、江苏 324 公里、安徽 328 公里、湖北 597 公里、重庆 343 公里、四川 354 公里。2014 年全线贯通时，新华社报道的全长为 1,966 公里。
鄂西那条著名的山区高速如今并不在 G42 上。自宜昌经恩施至利川、建有四渡河悬索桥的沪蓉西高速公路，原是作为本线的一部分规划的，并以此项目名于 2003—2010 年建成；但此后规划调整，该路今属 G50 沪渝高速。G42 在更北面穿越同一片山地，走的是宜巴高速。

en: The Yichang–Badong section is the hardest piece of the road. Its 173 km have 138 bridges and 39 tunnels, so that 74.5 per cent of the length is on structures, and more than 90 per cent between Xingshan and Badong. Xinhua listed the ground it had to cross: 70 km of slopes above the Three Gorges reservoir whose banks are still re-forming, about 30 km of pyrite country where stream and fissure water reaches pH 3.9, 5 km of gypsum rock, and about 30 km of the Badong formation, a soft rock that slumps when wet. The longest tunnel is Shimenya, about 7.5 km; the last to open was Jieling, 5.68 km, at 23:58 on 27 December 2014.

The Chongqing section beyond is a mountain road too, limited to 80 km/h, with the Motianling tunnel of about 7.3 km between Wushan and Fengjie. On the Sichuan border the Mingyueshan tunnel, 6.557 km per bore, was the longest expressway tunnel in Sichuan when it opened in 2009.

At the eastern end the Shanghai–Nanjing expressway was built in 1992–1996 as four lanes on a 26-metre roadbed for 120 km/h, and widened to eight in 2003–2005 by adding two lanes either side while traffic kept running. The Chengdu–Nanchong expressway at the western end, opened in 2002 with four lanes for most of its length, was rebuilt over 240 km from 2018: eight lanes on the old line and six on three new bypass sections, reopening throughout on 31 December 2025.
zh: 宜巴段是全线最难修的一段。173 公里内有桥梁 138 座、隧道 39 座，桥隧比 74.5%，兴山至巴东段超过 90%。新华社列举了它要穿越的地质：70 公里三峡库区岸坡，库岸仍在再造；约 30 公里硫铁矿区，河沟和裂隙水 pH 值低至 3.9；约 5 公里石膏质岩；约 30 公里巴东组软岩，遇水软化、极易滑塌。最长的是石门垭隧道，约 7.5 公里；最后通车的是长 5.68 公里的界岭隧道，时间是 2014 年 12 月 27 日 23 时 58 分。
其西的重庆段同样是山区高速，限速每小时 80 公里，巫山与奉节之间有长约 7.3 公里的摩天岭隧道。川渝交界的明月山隧道单洞长 6.557 公里，2009 年通车时是四川最长的高速公路隧道。
东端的沪宁高速于 1992—1996 年按四车道、路基宽 26 米、设计时速 120 公里建成，2003—2005 年采用边通车边施工的方式在两侧各拼宽两车道，扩建为八车道。西端的成南高速 2002 年通车时大部分为四车道，2018 年起扩容改造 240 公里：原路加宽为八车道，另建三段六车道复线，2025 年 12 月 31 日全线建成通车。

en: The eastern pieces are among the oldest expressways on the mainland. The Hefei–Nanjing expressway, Anhui's first, was begun in October 1986 and opened on 4 October 1991. The Shanghai–Nanjing expressway was studied with Japanese experts in 1986–87 under an intergovernmental agreement, approved by the State Council in February 1991 and opened in September 1996, Jiangsu's first expressway, cutting the drive between the two cities from six or seven hours to under three. In the 1992 trunk-road plan the corridor was line 055, Shanghai–Chengdu.

The west was built in the 2000s: Chengdu–Nanchong opened on 23 December 2002 and Wanzhou–Dianjiang on 12 December 2003; the Linshui–Dianjiang link with the Mingyueshan tunnel on 1 January 2009; the Lu'an–Wuhan road over the Dabie mountains in Anhui on 28 December 2009 and its Hubei continuation to Wuhan in 2010–2011; Fengjie–Yunyang and the first part of Wushan–Fengjie on 30 September 2010. In the 2005 national plan the line became G42 — the east–west lines take even numbers counted from north to south.

By 2012, Xinhua reported, everything was open except Yichang–Badong, and through traffic used the old provincial road. Work there had begun on 9 July 2009; sections opened in September 2012 and June 2014, and the Chuyang tunnel on the Chongqing border in July 2014. When the Jieling tunnel opened on the night of 27 December 2014 the whole road was complete.
zh: 东段几条路是中国大陆最早的高速公路之一。安徽省第一条高速公路合宁高速于 1986 年 10 月动工，1991 年 10 月 4 日通车。沪宁高速 1986—1987 年根据中日政府间科技合作协定与日方专家共同开展可行性研究，1991 年 2 月经国务院批准，1996 年 9 月建成通车，是江苏省第一条高速公路，宁沪间车程由六七个小时缩短至三小时以内。在 1992 年的国道主干线规划中，这条通道是 055 号沪蓉线。

西段建于 2000 年代：成南高速 2002 年 12 月 23 日通车，万州至垫江段 2003 年 12 月 12 日通车；含明月山隧道的邻垫高速 2009 年 1 月 1 日通车；翻越大别山的六武高速安徽段 2009 年 12 月 28 日通车，湖北境内接续至武汉的麻武高速 2010—2011 年通车；奉云高速和巫奉高速一期 2010 年 9 月 30 日通车。2005 年国家高速公路网规划将本线编为 G42——东西横线取偶数，自北向南编号。
据新华社报道，到 2012 年，除宜巴段外各段均已通车，过往车辆须绕行省道。宜巴段 2009 年 7 月 9 日开工，2012 年 9 月和 2014 年 6 月分段通车，渝鄂界的楚阳隧道 2014 年 7 月通车。2014 年 12 月 27 日深夜界岭隧道通车，沪蓉高速全线贯通。

en: No cost for the whole road has been published; it was financed section by section by the six provinces and their expressway companies. The Shanghai–Nanjing expressway was budgeted at 7.04 billion yuan and actually cost 6.21 billion; widening it in 2003–2005 cost close to another 10 billion. Yichang–Badong cost more than 100 million yuan a kilometre, according to Xinhua — 40 million more than the Shanghai–Chengdu West road and over three times the Hubei section of G4 — and had a US$150 million World Bank loan, the first road project in China for which the World Bank alone was responsible for environmental supervision.

In Chongqing, Yunyang–Wanzhou cost 6.249 billion yuan, of which 2.187 billion was the project's own capital and 2.92 billion a China Development Bank loan; Fengjie–Yunyang about 5.7 billion for 71 km. Rebuilding Chengdu–Nanchong was budgeted at 38 billion. Like nearly all mainland expressways it is tolled, with the first stretch in Shanghai, from Wuning Road to the Jiangqiao toll plaza, and the Nanjing ring-road section free.
zh: 全线总造价没有公开数字，各段由六个省市及其高速公路公司分别筹资建设。沪宁高速概算 70.4 亿元，实际投资 62.1 亿元；2003—2005 年扩建又投入近百亿元。据新华社报道，宜巴高速每公里造价超过 1 亿元，比沪蓉西高出 4,000 万元，是京港澳高速湖北段的三倍多；该路使用世界银行贷款 1.5 亿美元，是世界银行首次在中国独立负责环境监理的公路项目。
重庆境内，万云高速总投资 62.49 亿元，其中项目资本金 21.87 亿元、国家开发银行贷款 29.2 亿元；奉云高速 71 公里总投资约 57 亿元。成南高速扩容总投资 380 亿元。与中国大陆几乎所有高速公路一样，它是收费公路；上海武宁路至江桥收费站一段以及南京绕城公路段免费通行。

en: Speeds drop as the road goes west. It is 120 km/h on the eight lanes in Shanghai and Jiangsu; in Hubei the limit is 100 km/h and 80 in tunnels; in Chongqing, and on most of the four-lane road in Sichuan, it is 80 km/h. The mountain run from Yichang to Wanzhou is almost continuous tunnel and viaduct.
zh: 越往西限速越低。上海、江苏境内八车道路段限速每小时 120 公里；湖北段限速 100 公里，隧道内 80 公里；重庆段以及四川境内大部分四车道路段限速 80 公里。宜昌至万州的山区路段几乎是隧道与高架桥首尾相接。

why.en: No total has been published. G42 was built by six provinces and municipalities as separately financed projects between 1986 and 2014, each accounted for on its own; sourced section figures are given below.
why.zh: 全线没有公开的总造价。G42 由六个省市在 1986 至 2014 年间分多个项目分别筹资建设、分别核算；下列为有来源的分段数字。

value.en: Budgeted at 7.04 billion yuan, actual cost 6.21 billion (1992–1996); widening to eight lanes in 2003–2005 close to 10 billion
value.zh: 概算 70.4 亿元，实际投资 62.1 亿元（1992—1996）；2003—2005 年扩建为八车道投资近百亿元

figures.source: China Development Report 1997 (中国发展报告); Guangming Daily, 12 May 2003; both as cited in Chinese Wikipedia, 沪宁高速公路

value.en: More than 100 million yuan a kilometre for 173 km (2009–2014), with a US$150 million World Bank loan. No total was given.
value.zh: 173 公里，每公里造价超过 1 亿元（2009—2014），使用世界银行贷款 1.5 亿美元。报道未给出总额。

figures.source: Xinhua, 28 December 2014, via gov.cn; Chinese Wikipedia, 上海－成都高速公路

value.en: Yunyang–Wanzhou, 78.2 km: 6.249 billion yuan, including a 2.92 billion China Development Bank loan. Fengjie–Yunyang, 71.4 km: about 5.7 billion (opened 2010). The Yunyang–Wanzhou figure is from a trust-fund prospectus, not checked against the builder's accounts.
value.zh: 万云段 78.2 公里 62.49 亿元，其中国家开发银行贷款 29.2 亿元；奉云段 71.4 公里约 57 亿元（2010 年通车）。万云段数字出自信托产品说明，尚未与建设单位账目核对。

figures.source: Ping An, 重庆万云高速公路项目贷款集合资金信托计划, archived; People's Daily Online (Chongqing), 8 October 2010; both as cited in Chinese Wikipedia, 上海－成都高速公路
The Cover (thecover.cn), as cited in Chinese Wikipedia, 上海－成都高速公路

value.en: The provinces and municipalities along the route and their expressway companies, repaid from tolls; a US$150 million World Bank loan for Yichang–Badong; China Development Bank loans in Chongqing.
value.zh: 沿线各省市及其高速公路公司出资，以通行费还贷；宜巴段使用世界银行贷款 1.5 亿美元；重庆段使用国家开发银行贷款。

figures.source: Chinese Wikipedia, 上海－成都高速公路; Xinhua, 28 December 2014, via gov.cn

value.en: 1,980 km in the 2022 plan and on the chainage; 1,966 km as reported on completion in 2014
value.zh: 2022 年规划及里程桩号为 1,980 公里；2014 年贯通时报道为 1,966 公里

figures.source: Chinese Wikipedia, 中华人民共和国国家高速公路网 and 上海－成都高速公路; Xinhua, 28 December 2014, via gov.cn

timeline.en: The Hefei–Nanjing expressway, Anhui's first, opens on 4 October.
timeline.zh: 10 月 4 日，安徽首条高速公路合宁高速通车。

timeline.en: The Shanghai–Nanjing expressway opens in September.
timeline.zh: 9 月，沪宁高速公路建成通车。
12 月 23 日，成南高速通车。
12 月 12 日，万州至垫江段通车。

timeline.en: The national expressway plan numbers the line G42; the widened Shanghai–Nanjing expressway is finished on 23 December.
timeline.zh: 国家高速公路网规划将本线编为 G42；12 月 23 日，沪宁高速八车道扩建完工。

timeline.en: The Mingyueshan tunnel road opens on 1 January; the Lu'an–Wuhan road over the Dabie mountains in Anhui on 28 December.
timeline.zh: 1 月 1 日，邻垫高速（明月山隧道）通车；12 月 28 日，六武高速安徽段通车。
9 月 30 日，奉云高速通车。
1 月 13 日，麻武高速全线通车。

timeline.en: The Jieling tunnel opens at 23:58 on 27 December, completing Yichang–Badong and the whole road.
timeline.zh: 12 月 27 日 23 时 58 分，界岭隧道通车，宜巴高速及沪蓉高速全线贯通。

timeline.en: The rebuilt Chengdu–Nanchong section opens throughout on 31 December.
timeline.zh: 12 月 31 日，成南高速扩容工程全线建成通车。
